description: Recorded TorWIC trajectory-ingestion integrity results. Counts describe payload validation, not model accuracy or sensor-registration certification.
scope: Both-camera RGB, measured depth, predicted semantic labels and XYZ LiDAR trajectory payloads
test_split_usage: Read-only integrity inspection; no model evaluation or tuning

evidence.description: The unchanged original record retains its historical source hashes and detailed evidence locations. These hashes describe the audited implementation, not subsequent readability edits.

limitations: Integrity checks do not establish calibration accuracy, registration or independent semantic accuracy.
IMU measurement interpolation and fusion require verified units, timing and coordinate-frame metadata; see docs/imu_ingestion_review.txt.
Extra annotated-set and ground-truth map payloads are outside this recorded trajectory audit.
